files.README.md:
# Cauldwell Chocolate - consignment sheet

consign.py prints the consignment sheet from the dispatch office's
final exports in consignments/. While a month's numbers are
settling, the office parks a draft in outbox/; a draft is re-issued
until the final export lands in consignments/, and the sheet reads
the final exports only. The exports in the two folders are the
office's own record.
